title: Face off in Venezuela
summary:
Tanker owners should closely follow the developments
On Wednesday, Mr. Juan Guaido, the head of the country's National Assembly, declared himself interim president of Venezuela. Maduro illegitimate and invoked a constitutional rule that transfers power to the head of the National Assembly if the presidency is vacated.
